chapter_title: Concerning Food: It shall be allocated to Five Products of the human Body.
chapter_note: Aside from the brief hagiographic dialogue opener, the chapter consists of an impersonal, systematic five-fold allocation of ingested food into bodily ‘productions,’ expressed in numbered sequence without citation, exhortation, or institutional application—characteristic of the old teaching layer.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Formulaic dialogue-frame opener (‘Once again…disciple’) typical of Kephalaia compilation apparatus.

paragraphs.core_text: This sustenance of various kinds that people gather in and eat, and enters the body; it shall be distributed to five productions.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Impersonal, expository setup announcing a numbered five-fold scheme; no citation or institutional vocabulary.

paragraphs.core_text: The first product is this that shall issue from the person in rapture and rises up in the Mind, and it comes out from all his limbs, and is immeasurable.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Numbered item in a structured list; physiological/psychological mapping (‘rapture’ → ‘Mind’ → ‘all his limbs’) in systematic descriptive voice.

paragraphs.core_text: The second is this that shall issue from the person in voice and word.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the numbered five-fold distribution in terse, schematic style.

paragraphs.core_text: The third is this that shall spring from them in strength and activity.
paragraphs.temporal_note: List-structure persists; abstract faculties (‘strength and activity’) treated as products—fits old correspondential/functional exposition.

paragraphs.core_text: The fourth is what is engendered by the pleasure of lu[s]t in men and women.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Still within the five-fold enumerative teaching; no paraenesis or church regulation, just mechanism/production language.

paragraphs.core_text: The fifth is this that shall be formed and sculpted in the flesh, and be engendered and come from them. It is this corporeal creature; only its parents can recognise this creature that they beget. They are attentive to its desire and its thought and its [lo]ve every day, all the time. However, these other four forms they neither notice nor are concerned about; because they are not displayed.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Expands the fifth item with explanatory contrast (visible child vs. unseen other ‘forms’). Still impersonal/descriptive, completing the five-fold schema without later ecclesial application.
